todo.title: Codify 11-State Modular Task Matrix
todo.details: Formalized pending/in-progress initial, review, audit, and refactor states along with completed, blocked, and deprecated terminal states using colon delimiter.

todo.title: Integrate Unblock Recovery, Sub-Task Hierarchy, and Metadata Properties
todo.details: Added reason and owner properties, dot-notation sub-task branching (TODO-01.1), unblock recovery paths, and trivial fast-track rules.

todo.title: Integrate Mandatory Priority, Relates-To Relational Linking, and Terminal Child Completion Rules
todo.details: Codified mandatory priority property, relates_to historical linking key, parent completion on child terminal state, section heading resilience, and numeric ID parsing.

todo.title: Integrate Sub-Task Letter Parts (TODO-01.1a), Strict Local Relational Scope, and Priority Escalation
todo.details: Codified sub-task letter parts (TODO-01.1a through TODO-01.1z) with strict single-level cap, enforced strict local-only relates_to scope, updated reason to Conditional, and codified priority escalation.

todo.title: Integrate Single-Letter Sub-Task Hard Limit, Acyclic Relational Links, Primary Key Uniqueness, and Task Quality Constraints
todo.details: Hard-limited sub-task letters to single a-z range forcing new top-level tasks beyond z, prohibited circular relates_to references, enforced primary key uniqueness, and set title/details quality length thresholds.

todo.title: Integrate Child_Of Ancestry Key and Decoupled Relates_To Horizontal Association
todo.details: Codified child_of property for immutable vertical ancestry guaranteeing acyclic lineage, alongside relates_to for loose horizontal association.

todo.title: Integrate Parent-Child Blocker Propagation, Referential Integrity, Priority Regex, and Pair Owner Syntax
todo.details: Codified parent blocker propagation when child tasks lock, enforced strict referential existence validation for child_of/relates_to, added priority regex validation, and standardized slash-delimited multi-owner syntax.

todo.title: Integrate Sub-Task Numerical Formatting, Parent Deprecation Cascade, Empty Array Validity, and String Normalization
todo.details: Codified unpadded integer sub-task numerical formatting (.1a), parent deprecation cascade to all active child tasks, empty todo array validity, and pre-validation string trimming rules.

todo.title: Integrate Parent Priority Dynamic Sync, 2-Space JSON Encoding Standard, 4-Digit ID Scaling, and Cascaded Deprecation Immutability
todo.details: Codified parent priority dynamic sync to highest sub-task priority, enforced 2-space indented UTF-8 JSON frontmatter, expanded ID regex to 4 digits (TODO-9999), and locked cascaded deprecation immutability.

todo.title: Integrate Optional Link Anchor Key for Pragmatic Navigation
todo.details: Codified optional link key allowing clean URI relative paths and section fragment anchors to navigate programmatically to target headings.

todo.title: Integrate Mandatory Section Anchor Key and Deprecate Presentation Text Keys
todo.details: Codified section key as mandatory anchor reference while deprecating raw presentation text keys in favor of clean URI strings.

todo.title: Integrate Conditionally Mandatory *-Since Version Origin Keys and Task Protection Governance Key
todo.details: Codified conditionally mandatory existed_since, blocked_since, and deprecated_since version tracking keys alongside protection governance status for completed tasks.

todo.title: Integrate Companion Dataset Storage Pattern and Metadata File Pointers
todo.details: Codified Mode 2 Companion Dataset Storage Pattern (todo_file and changelog_file metadata pointers) alongside Mode 1 embedded inline frontmatter.

todo.title: Standardize Companion Dataset Filename (todo.json / todo.yaml) and Non-Redundant Major Version Naming
todo.details: Standardized companion dataset filename to todo.json or todo.yaml inside version directories, eliminating version number redundancy from internal filenames.
